'''Pressik''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served as an officer in the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
In [[3640 BBY]], he commanded one of the [[Orbital Defense Command Center]]'s Emergency Response Teams on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. [[Theron Shan]], a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] working for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], planning to steal the [[Black cipher|Black Cipher]] from the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] and complete an [[Infiltration of the Ascendant Spear|assault]] on [[Darth Karrid]]'s [[Ascendant Spear]], uncovered Pressik's reputation for being drunk and violent. He visited Pressik in a bar on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], starting a confrontation to try and get a scan of Pressik's retinas in order to infiltrate the [[Orbital Defense Command Center|ODCC]].

At first, Pressik did not respond to [[Theron Shan|Theron's]] attempts to begin confrontation, simply turning away, but eventually, the two engaged in a brawl, [[Theron Shan|Theron]] managing to get a scan of Pressik's retinas.

Later on, when [[Theron Shan|Theron]] infiltrated the [[Orbital Defense Command Center|ODCC]], Pressik, along with the rest of his Emergency Response Team were some of the first on the site of the [[Orbital Defense Command Center|ODCC]] Infiltration, the team engaged in a shootout with [[Theron Shan|Theron]] until [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] appeared to help [[Theron Shan|Theron]], killing Pressik and his Response Team.

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Pressik was considered to be arrogant and always saw himself as superior than everyone else, Pressik was a very heavy drinker, and when he got drunk, he got violent. Though he was always intelligent enough to pick fights with civilians rather than harm his military career.
